Body.Content:
When someone shares a page in chat or a channel, you can open it in Teams, edit, and discuss with teammates. Open a page in your main Teams window or a new window, whichever works best for you.

More info: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/teams/teams-channels/manage-pages-and-loop-components-in-channels

GA date: January CY2027

Preview date: January CY2027
